source_text: Si tota synagoga erraverit, vitulum offerunt. Anima una — capram vel ovem. Gradus peccati gradus hostiae. Christus pro populo et pro singulis.
pass_a_gloss: If whole synagogue will-have-erred, calf they-offer. Soul one — she-goat or sheep. Degrees of-sin degrees of-victim. Christ for people and for individuals.
pass_b_english: If the whole assembly errs, they bring a [[bull >> Bible:Leviticus 4:13-14]]; one soul brings a goat or sheep. The grade of sin matches the grade of victim. Christ dies for the people and for each.
